guidance: The deliverable is curated news items (and the narrative chapters built from them); the sources are the archived full article text in the collection's sources/. Exactness is load-bearing: every quote in an item must be VERBATIM in a source, and every factual assertion (numbers, dates, who-said-what, capability claims) must be supported. Flag headline-style overstatement, quotes that drift from the source, and capability claims that garble the original announcement. Editorial verification is the model's judgement; scripts only convert formats.
note: Layout assumed: a collection folder holding items/, outputs/chapters/, an archived sources/ directory and an analysis/ folder for audit output. Edit the globs if your workspace differs. Run per collection, resolving {name} to the collection identifier (e.g. a month, 2026-05). Chapters reference items, so check items first; a chapter claim that traces to a verified item is fine.
